label: Webinar Cover
description: An event's own cover (the email header, the social card) as a live card, left-aligned like the cover: a pill ('FREE WEBINAR'), a kicker ('A live, 45-minute session'), the big title with one *word* in the accent italic, the line under it, a rule, and the date and time on tinted icon tiles. Open a film on it (still:true: the first frame is the cover) and close on it again with button_text (the same cover with the register button). ground 'waves' gives the card its own cream sheet with the announce email's waves, so it stands full-frame over footage (the opener of a speaker film: exit slide-up on a word to reveal the person). Leave the speakers off; people-row names them. Type sizes from the box.

title.label: The event title; *word* is set in the accent italic, a newline breaks the line ('Claude for\nMarketing *Analytics*')

pill.label: Pill above the title (e.g. 'FREE WEBINAR'); omit for none

kicker.label: Small line above the title (e.g. 'A live, 45-minute session')

date.label: Date on the calendar tile; a newline splits it ('Tuesday\nOctober 20, 2026')

time.label: Time on the clock tile ('1:00 – 1:45 PM ET')

button_text.label: Register button under the cover (the close)

accent.label: Accent colour: the pill, the italic word, the tiles, the button (default the cover orange #e0703f)

ground.label: The card's own sheet: 'none' (default, the scene's ground shows) | 'cream' | 'waves' (cream with the announce email's waves) -- use over footage

still.label: Shown whole from the first frame, no entrance (an opener whose first frame is the cover)

at.label: Seconds: the lines rise (default 0.2; ignored with still)

button_at.label: Seconds: the button lands (default right after the lines)

press_at.label: Seconds: the button presses (pair with a cursor click)
